summary_en: 30,000,000 shares (5.5% of S/O ex-treasury), ¥80.0B upper limit, open-market purchase via ToSTNeT-3, Aug 3–Oct 30, 2026. Post stock-split effective Oct 1, 2026, total authorization becomes 90,000,000 shares. Objective: capital efficiency and enhanced shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition framework for treasury shares (acquisition pursuant to provisions of Articles of Incorporation based on Company Law Article 165, Paragraph 2)
translation_en_brief: Kioxia Holdings resolved on July 31, 2026 to establish a treasury share acquisition framework under Company Law Article 165(3), read in conjunction with Article 156. The acquisition covers up to 30,000,000 ordinary shares (5.5% of shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026, excluding treasury stock) within a ¥80.0 billion aggregate purchase ceiling. Execution window runs August 3 through October 30, 2026 via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a committed trading contract. The company stated the acquisition aims to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns, consistent with its capital allocation policy that balances growth investment (particularly in AI and data center markets) with financial soundness. A stock split effective October 1, 2026 will proportionately increase the authorization to 90,000,000 shares post-split. Execution is subject to market conditions; the company noted all or part of the acquisition may not occur. The reference denominator is 548,014,638 shares outstanding ex-treasury as of June 30, 2026.
